bootstrap.outcome_quote: The results of the 1000 bootstraps showed adequate confidence intervals for the majority of parameters, with 993 of the bootstraps

theta_cl.label: CL/F (L/h), typical at FFM 55 kg and CrCl 90 mL/min

notes: The %RSE column is from the final model's covariance step; the bootstrap interval is a separate estimate of the same uncertainty. For CL/F and Vd/F they agree (a 95% interval of plus or minus about 10%). For KTR they do not: an RSE of 5.8% implies about 12.0 to 15.0 1/h, while the bootstrap gives 11.9 to 36.8, so the bootstrap shows a long upper tail the RSE misses. For the CrCl exponent both are wide.
